verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any registrable outbound webhooks that Modal fires on platform events such as deployments, function completions or budget alerts. The closest item lets users turn a function into an inbound HTTPS endpoint, which is a building block for receiving webhooks from elsewhere, not Modal emitting event callbacks. Webhooks are a fair axis for a cloud compute platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
